## Download

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10/11** | `ChessArena-Setup-<version>.exe` (installer, updates itself) or `ChessArena-<version>-portable.exe` (no install) |
| **Mac with Apple Silicon** (M1 or newer) | `ChessArena-<version>-arm64.dmg` |
| **Mac with Intel** | `ChessArena-<version>-x64.dmg` |

**First launch:** these builds are not code-signed yet, so your computer will warn you once.

- **Windows:** "Windows protected your PC" → click **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** open the .dmg and drag Chess Arena to Applications, then open it. When macOS says it can't verify the app, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.

See the [README](https://github.com/OCode3546/chess-arena#readme) for details, and [What's new](https://github.com/OCode3546/chess-arena/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for the changes in this version.
